I would **urgently flag the box to the manager/duty manager before release**, emphasizing that the contents are the only copies and Claire cannot collect them before Wednesday. But I would **not change its storage date or take it off the manifest** without the required written permission.

The collection booking and the 9 October request do not alter the expiry date. The request is still pending, and the next approval sitting is tomorrow—after today’s scheduled destruction. The policy also says permission must be registered before a date change, and the manager has directed the team to make no discretionary extensions and release the full batch on time.

On the facts given, no compliant permission can be registered before today’s deadline. So I would document the escalation and, absent valid written authorization by 13:30, release the full manifest including this box. I would not silently hold the box or delay the batch; neither is authorized by the policy. The unique, irreplaceable contents make the escalation urgent, but do not themselves authorize an extension.
